thread:
Adele R: quick handover — i'm handing primary to @Jin Park at 04:15 UTC. leaving two live items and a short checklist.

Adele R: item A: intermittent 503s from bgtask-kvcache seen since ~03:50 UTC (eu region). item B: us-west ingest p95 spiking; not full outage but customer-facing latency for streaming ingest.

IncidentBot: new incident created INC-20260315-17 — assigned to eng-oncall primary. Pager sent to Adele R and Jin Park.

Jin Park: taking primary. thanks adele. quick ask — are there any active deploys?

Adele R: no deploys. last deploy was 02:40 UTC. i've attached current quick checks below.

Adele R: quick checks i ran:
- `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep kv-cache` -> 3/5 restarts on kv-cache-2
- `tail -n 200 /var/log/kv-cache/worker.log` -> repeated "evict failed: connection reset by peer" lines
- `cloudwatch->eu metrics` shows error rate jump at 03:49

Priya S: looping in SRE — i'll open a blameless note and ping support for customer comms. tagging ops-bridge.

OpsBridge: bridging channel created: https://meet.redwood/ops/INC-20260315-17. use that for voice if you escalate.

Mike L: i'll own rapid mitigation for kvcache. plan: check upstream redis health, then drain and restart the affected pods if redis is ok.

Jin Park: i’ll monitor ingress p95 and audit recent routing changes. linking runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-failover and https://docs.redwood.com/playbooks/ingest-latency. follow the kv-cache checklist first.

Adele R: kv-cache quick play (condensed):
1) check redis cluster health: `redis-cli -h redis-eu-1 info replication`
2) if redis replicas are ok, cordon node `kubectl cordon <node>` and drain pods: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
3) restart the kv-cache deployment: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache -n prod`
4) tail logs, confirm error rate back to baseline, then uncordon node

Mike L: i'm running `redis-cli` now. if redis shows master failover, we follow runbook step B (promote replica). else we'll restart pods.

IncidentBot: update INC-20260315-17: redis cluster ok, 1 replica lagging (30s).

Mike L: replica lag consistent but not catastrophic. proceeding with `kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache -n prod` on eu-primary nodes.

Jin Park: on the ingest side, i see a thundering pattern from a single customer stream; throttling might help. suggested temporary mitigation: apply rate-limit for that client: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/ratelimit --data '{"client":"acct-9876","limit":200}'`

Priya S: i'll prep customer comms if we need to throttle. also adding oncall-sre to watch for any downstream alerts.

Adele R: NOTE: if restart doesn't reduce 503s, fallback is to route traffic from eu -> us-east pool (costly but fast). routing switch command (ops-only): `scripts/switch_pool.sh --from=eu-pool --to=useast-pool --dry-run` then remove `--dry-run` to enact.

Mike L: restart done on 3 pods. logs show connection errors stop after ~45s. error rate trending down in cloudwatch.

Jin Park: ingest p95 improving after we throttled that client to 200 rps. p95 dropped from 820ms -> 230ms.

Priya S: customer comms draft ready: "We observed transient errors impacting API ingestion in EU. Mitigation applied; no data loss. If you see continued issues contact support." ready to send on approval.

Adele R: looks stable. leaving Jin as primary. Jin please confirm you accept handover and that you'll keep monitoring for 30m. i'll stay on standby for escalation.

Jin Park: accepting primary. will monitor logs and run alert sweep every 5m for 30m. i have runbook links pinned and alerts configured. thanks team. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: INC-20260315-17 status -> mitigated (monitoring). auto-close scheduled in 2 hours if no regressions.

Mike L: adding quick notes to runbook: `kv-cache` restart reduced 503s; likely cause: transient redis connection blips + one noisy client on ingest. follow-up: add better client backpressure and increase replica monitoring thresholds.

Priya S: i'll open a follow-up ticket for post-mortem with action items: add circuit-breaker for noisy clients, extend redis monitoring retention, and run chaos test for connection resets.

Adele R: handoff complete. thanks everyone.

Jin Park: confirmed. switching slack status to `Oncall (primary)` and will post a 30m check-in.

OpsBridge: closing voice bridge. summary and links stored at https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/INC-20260315-17

Adele R: :coffee: good handoff, nice quick triage.

Jin Park: thanks — will ping if anything pops back up.
